Calculating multiples of \( 31 \):
- \( 31 \times 1 = 31 \)
- \( 31 \times 2 = 62 \)
- \( 31 \times 3 = 93 \mod 73 \equiv 20 \)

- \( 31 \times 9 = 279 \mod 73 \equiv 6 \)

- \( 31 \times 13 = 403 \mod 73 \equiv 12 \)

- \( 31 \times 15 = 465 \mod 73 \equiv 1 \)

I find that when \( x = 15 \), \( 31x \equiv 1 \mod 73 \).

Final answer: 15
